description: Blank Space is mother being self-aware about her 'boy crazy serial dater' reputation and it is ICONIC 😤✨ 'Darling I'm a nightmare dressed like a daydream' is the single best self-description in pop history. The satire of it all, the way she mocks the tabloids, the Harry Styles era energy?? chef's kiss. It's clever, it's catchy, it's a full serve and I scream every word 💅🔥
